---
output: html_document
---

```{r fun_defs}
striped <- function(data) {
  gt::gt(data) %>% 
    gt::tab_options(table.align = "left") %>% 
    gtExtras::gt_theme_excel(color = "#aaa") %>% 
    gt::sub_missing(missing_text = "")
}

excelish <- function(data) {
  striped(data) %>%
    gt::opt_row_striping(FALSE)
}
# add tooltips to gt column titles:
with_tooltip <- function(value, tooltip) {
    htmltools::tags$abbr(
        style = "text-decoration: underline;
    text-decoration-style: solid; color: blue",
    title = tooltip,
    value
    ) %>% 
        as.character()
}
```
